purpose: Disentangle single-best reconstruction, multi-hypothesis retention, public-I1 weighting, and production minimax allocation using the already frozen top-14 M3 support.

budget.production_reference: existing frozen M3 B=1400 minimax allocation

estimators.UNIFORM14_EQ_1400: equal weight 1/14 over 14 retained hypotheses, 100 shared-CRN trajectories each
estimators.WEIGHTED14_EQ_1400: frozen alpha weights over same 14x100 shared-CRN trajectories
estimators.WEIGHTED14_MINIMAX_1400: existing frozen production M3 B=1400 prediction

primary_comparisons.retention_effect: WEIGHTED14_EQ_1400 minus TOP1_1400 in MAE; negative favors weighted multi-hypothesis retention
primary_comparisons.weighting_effect: WEIGHTED14_EQ_1400 minus UNIFORM14_EQ_1400 in MAE; negative favors public-I1 weighting
primary_comparisons.allocation_effect_secondary: WEIGHTED14_MINIMAX_1400 minus WEIGHTED14_EQ_1400 in MAE; descriptive only because seed banks differ

bootstrap.role: graph-Monte-Carlo diagnostic with frozen WB point estimates
bootstrap.uniform_weighted_pairing: resample the same 100 shared seed units for Uniform14 and Weighted14-EQ
reported: retention-effect delta MAE percentile95 using replicate-index coupling only; not a strict paired bootstrap
bootstrap.does_not_include: white-box reference uncertainty or model-support uncertainty

stop_rule: After Stage B, do not tune or add variants. Interpret the frozen ablation as-is and close the pilot mechanism audit.
